title: Pointwise slice-mass bound M_W(∂(T⌞{f<t}) − (∂T)⌞{f<t}) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t−h<f<t}) (Simon Ch. 6, 4.9 for Lipschitz f)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set, T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), μ, μ' measures on ℝ^P with μ(K), μ'(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_{k+1}(ℝ^P) μ-a.e. strongly measurable and ξ' : ℝ^P → Λ_k(ℝ^P) μ'-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ-a.e. x and |ξ'(x)(α')| ≤ |α'| for μ'-a.e. x (all covectors α, α'; |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm), T(ω) = ∫ ξ(ω) dμ for ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(U) and ∂T(θ) = ∫ ξ'(θ) dμ' for θ ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be L-Lipschitz (L ≥ 0), t ∈ ℝ, W ⊆ ℝ^P any set, and A ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), B ∈ 𝒟_k(U) with A(ω) = ∫_{{f<t}} ξ(ω) dμ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(U) and B(θ) = ∫_{{f<t}} ξ'(θ) dμ' for every θ ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Then, in [0, ∞], M_W(∂A − B) ≤ L·liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}), where M_W is SimonGMT massOn (supremum of ofReal((∂A − B)(η)) over η ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport η ⊆ W and |η(x)| ≤ 1 for all x) and ∂A − B is the difference of currents of the frozen contract.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (k + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (t : ℝ) (A : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (W : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (k + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ θ : TestFormOn U k, T.boundary θ = ∫ x, ξ' x ((θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → LipschitzWith L f → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), A ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ θ : TestFormOn U k, B θ = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((θ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → (A.boundary - B).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (W ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0)
